summary: Iteration 6 — tested inline status dropdown on /ventes + TAP source. Found and fixed one CRITICAL blocker: Sales.jsx used SALE_STATUSES without importing it, causing a full white-screen ReferenceError on /ventes (page unusable). After adding the missing import, all P0 flows pass. Backend: 13 new tests (test_status_tap_iter6.py) + full regression suite = 68/68 passing.

PDF generates 200 application/pdf but table header is still hardcoded R1/Assist/CQ/CA — TAP sales are not visible in the PDF (accepted for this iteration per request).

issues: Monthly report table has no TAP column (headers R1/Assist/CQ/CA only) although backend now returns sources.TAP — TAP sales are invisible in this report. Sales page 'CA par commercial' table does show TAP correctly.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the blocker: the new status DropdownMenu in Sales.jsx mapped over SALE_STATUSES but the import statement only pulled STATUS_MAP/SOURCE_MAP/SOURCES from @/lib/saleConstants, so React threw ReferenceError during render of the Sales page → CRA error overlay, no rows visible. Fix: add SALE_STATUSES to the import list. Re-tested end-to-end after fix: all flows green.
